verdict.rationale: Visa documents a genuine self-serve onboarding flow: a public 'Intelligent Commerce Sandbox Sign up' form with terms acceptance that immediately unlocks test transactions (visa-ic-supp-10), plus an open, publishable Trusted Agent Protocol reference implementation merchants can deploy to declare/verify agent traffic (visa-ic-supp-9, visa-intelligent-commerce-gh-1/2). However, production enablement is explicitly gated — 'Contact Visa for fees in Production' (visa-ic-supp-8) — meaning the fully self-serve path only covers sandbox/dev, not live acceptance. Missing for 10: a documented self-serve production activation step (no sales contact), and independent merchant confirmation that the sandbox-to-production path works without manual Visa involvement.
